subject: Zoda-Y
text: Zoda-Y is located in Dracula's Castle.

subject: Dracula's Castle
text: When you walk into the room, move forward a little bit, because spikes will come out of the floor right in front of the entrance.

evidence.quote:
When you walk into the room, move forward a little bit, because spikes will come 
out of 	  	  the floor right in front of the entrance.

subject: Zoda-Y
text: The safest way to win against Zoda-Y is to take the bats out first and nail Zoda just a few times before he teleports away.

evidence.quote:
Zoda will stand on the other side 
of the room, 	  and will release a couple of bats which'll fly and attack you.  The safest 
way to win 	  	  this is to take the bats out first and nail Zoda just a few times 
before he teleports 	  	  away.

subject: Zoda-Y
text: After a short while, Zoda will get on his knees and grab his chest in pain, and change into his alternate form of an owl creature.

evidence.quote:
After a 
short while, Zoda will get on his knees 	  and grab his chest in pain, making you think 
it's over.  That's when he'll change into  	  	  his alternate form, which is that of 
some sort of owl creature (the original Zoda had 	  	  one, it was the freaky slobbery 
guy).

subject: Zoda-Y
text: In his alternate form, Zoda will launch more bats while jumping side to side, flap his wings to push you into the spikes by the doorway, and shoot razor sharp feathers at you.

evidence.quote:
he will launch 	  more bats at you, while jumping 
side to side.  He'll eventually stop moving so that he 	  	  can flap his wings, and 
push you into the spikes by the doorway.  At the same time, there 	  are bats flying around 
the room, and Zoda is shooting razor sharp feathers at you.

subject: Zoda-Y
text: Use the Mace weapon here, and the shockwave when you run out.

evidence.quote:
Use the Mace weapon here, 	 	  
and the shockwave when you run out.

subject: Zoda-Y
text: To dodge the feathers, get right up against one side of your platform so that they all go in that direction, and then make one clean jump across to the side.

evidence.quote:
Jumping over the feathers will probably 
be 	  	  the hardest, so I suggest getting right up against one side of your 
platform, so that 	  	  they all go in that direction, and then making one clean jump 
across to the side.

subject: Knight
text: The Knight is located in Dragon's Cave.

subject: Knight
text: On a ring of conveyor belts that move you quickly around the level while the knight moves back and forth shooting bullets in two directions, use the Shockwave in the knight's direction to hit him and jump over his shots.

evidence.quote:
You'll be on a ring of conveyer belts that will move you quickly around the level.  
The 	  	  knight will move back and forth shooting bullets in two directions, so you 
don't really 	  	  have much of a choice on what to do.  Use the Shockwave in the 
knight's direction and 	  	  hope to hit him.  Jump over his shots if it looks like 
they'll hit you, even though they 	  	  usually don't.

subject: The Dragon
text: The Dragon is located in Dragon's Cave, Part II.

evidence.quote:
Name: The Dragon
Area: Dragon's Cave, Part II

subject: The Dragon
text: You have to hit The Dragon's head while he slowly walks forward, blasting fire in three directions, while a field of spikes begins to grow.

evidence.quote:
Because I 	  had no idea you had to hit his head.  He'll slowly walk forward, blasting 
fire in three 	  	  directions, while a field of spikes begins to grow.

subject: The Dragon
text: Stay near the bottom right corner and jump while using the Ultra Psychic Shockwave to hit his head, and when he starts to fly and shoot bullets, walk in a counter-clockwise circle to avoid him and beat him quickly before the spikes consume you.

evidence.quote:
When he gets too 
close to attack, 	  	  he'll fly around shooting bullets at you.  Stay near the 
bottom right corner and jump 	  	  while using the Ultra Psychic Shockwave to hit his 
head, and when he starts to fly, walk 	  	  in a counter-clockwise circle to avoid 
him and the bullets.  You have to beat him 	  	  	  quickly, or the spikes will 
consume you.

subject: C-Serpent
text: C-Serpent moves from side to side and breathes fire in three directions, and you should use the mace weapon against him.

evidence.quote:
He'll move from side to 
side, 	  and breath fire in three directions, like the mace weapon, which you should use.  
Dodge 	  	  his attacks and keep fighting, he should go down rather easily.

subject: Zoda-Z
text: Zoda-Z starts off as a bunch of Offspring Larva creatures where one is colored differently than the others, and you must attack that one while dodging the others until they group together.

evidence.quote:
He starts off as a bunch of 
those 	 	  Offspring Larva creatures, one of which is colored differently than the 
others.  Attack 	  	  that one while dodging the others for a while.  Soon they'll 
group together into the more	 	 recognizable form.

subject: Zoda-Z
text: Zoda-Z launches large balls of energy that do not do damage, but on impact turn you into a wild boar incapable of attacking, so run around dodging his bullets until it wears off.

evidence.quote:
He starts off with an attack that 
launches large balls of energy.  	 	  They don't do damage, but on impact, they turn 
you into a wild boar!  You'll be incapable 	  of attacking, so if this happens just run 
around dodging his bullets until it wears off.

subject: Zoda-Z
text: Once you defeat him with the Shockwave, he morphs into a large creature that resembles a buffalo standing on two legs.

evidence.quote:
Once you defeat him with the Shockwave, 
he'll get busy.  He morphs into a large creature 	  	  that resembles a buffalo 
standing on two legs.

subject: Zoda-Z
text: In his buffalo form, Zoda-Z fires bullets, can change you into a boar, fires walls of fire from sides of the room, makes areas explode with sparks, and can spin quickly to become invincible and charge at you.

evidence.quote:
He still fires 
bullets and can change you into a boar, but he can also do three new 	  	  	  
things: fire walls of fire from sides of the room, make areas of the room explode with 	  
	  sparks, and he can spin quickly (which makes him invincible) and charge at you with 
his 		  body.
